column6: + Add effective address calculation time. | † Word or long only | * Indicates maximum basic value added to word effective address time | ** The base time of six clock periods is increased to eight if the effective address mode is register direct or immediate (effective address time should also be added). | *** Only available effective address mode is data register direct. | DIVS, DIVU — The divide algorithm used by the MC68000 provides less than 10% difference between the best- and worst-case timings. | MULS, MULU — The multiply algorithm requires 38+2n clocks where n is defined as: MULU: n = the number of ones in the <ea>; MULS: n = concatenate the <ea> with a zero as the LSB; n is the resultant number of 10 or 01 patterns in the 17-bit source; i.e., worst case happens when the source is $5555.
